description: llama-server launch for the roleplay/feedback LLM (PROTOCOL §1, §5). Paths are relative to the repo root.
verified_with: llama-server version: 0.5.0 (build 11146, commit 7fe450e19), Homebrew, macOS arm64 (Apple M3 Pro)

notes.-c 8192 -np 2 --no-kv-unified: two slots with a fixed 4096-token context each (PRD §11 budget); slot 0 = realtime roleplay, slot 1 = feedback/jobs
notes.--cache-prompt: default on; listed explicitly because the roleplay prefix cache depends on it
notes.LLAMA_API_KEY: llama-server answers CORS for any Origin, so without a key any web page could use it. /health stays open without the key.
